# vendor/

`diagramium-player-0.2.0.tgz` is the [diagramium-player](https://github.com/diagramium/diagramium-player) v0.2.0 release, packed from its `v0.2.0` tag with `npm pack`. It is the drawing engine this panel bundles.

It lives here until 0.2.0 is on npm; then `package.json` switches to `"diagramium-player": "^0.2.0"` and this folder goes away.
